Thanks Alice for the notes. A few follow-up points:

1. The PostgreSQL migration timeline looks tight. I suggest we start with
   a staging environment test before committing to production.

2. For the embedding upgrade, we should benchmark the new model against
   our existing test cases to ensure retrieval quality doesn't degrade.

3. The reranking model change needs evaluation - we have synthetic test
   cases that measure recall, MRR, and nDCG scores.

Let me know if anyone has concerns about the proposed timeline.
